name: Somchai Sae-Lim
bio:
Somchai's motorsport journey began unexpectedly during his university days, where a chance encounter with a local racing team ignited his passion. Initially volunteering as a data analyst, his knack for spotting patterns and optimizing performance quickly became evident. Over the years, he honed his skills, developing a keen understanding of race strategy and vehicle dynamics. His analytical mind and ability to anticipate on-track scenarios have made him an invaluable asset to any team. 

Somchai's approach to race strategy is characterized by meticulous preparation and a willingness to adapt. He believes in empowering his team with the knowledge and tools they need to make informed decisions under pressure. What sets Somchai apart is his unwavering commitment to innovation. He constantly seeks new ways to improve performance, whether it's through advanced data analysis techniques or unconventional race strategies. He is driven by a desire to push the boundaries of what's possible, always striving to find the edge that will give his team the competitive advantage.

physical.description: Somchai is a wiry man with a focused gaze, often seen adjusting his glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with racing statistics.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Refuses to start a race without first drinking a cup of strong Thai iced coffee.
